===== asb_page_admissions.html =====
ASB Admissions 2026 | Eligibility & Application Process 
Candidates seeking admission in  BBA / BCA / B.Com / B.Sc (CS)/ BA (Hons) Psychology   Specialization Degree Programme must have passed 10+2 (or its equivalent) examination from a recognized Board/University. Candidates appearing for the qualifying examination or those who are awaiting their results are also eligible to apply. Their candidature, however, shall be considered subject to their clearing the qualifying examination. 
Candidates interested in  BBA / BCA / B.Com / B.Sc (CS) / BA (Hons) Psychology  Specialization Degree Programme are supposed to register their names for Online Entrance Test (O.E.T) to be conducted by ASB, Noida at their campus. The test is based on general awareness, basic mathematics, reasoning ability and communication skills. You can download the application form from  https://www.asb.edu.in  and send it to Admissions Department at ASB.

An elite global undergraduate program combining advanced computing, soft skills, and international academic exposure. 
Asian School of Business (ASB)  proudly offers the  Bachelor of Science (B.Sc.) in Computer Science – International , a three-year full-time degree program. This program stands out with its  exclusive International Certification  in  Advanced Computing & Professional Development , complemented by a  15-day fully paid residential workshop and certification from Oxford Business College, Oxford & London, UK . 
This program is designed to provide students with a  strong foundation in computer science, programming, and emerging technologies  while integrating essential problem-solving and analytical skills. Our curriculum fosters an  innovative learning environment , preparing students to become  highly skilled IT professionals  ready to excel in the global tech industry. 
The B.Sc. (CS) International program at ASB is meticulously crafted to blend theoretical expertise with hands-on industry experience. Students will develop and implement live projects, gaining practical knowledge in software development, data analytics, and system security, ensuring they are well-equipped for careers in tech-driven industries worldwide. 
By integrating academic rigour with global exposure and professional development, the B.Sc. (CS) International program helps students develop a broader understanding of technology and prepares them to contribute effectively in a dynamic global economy.

The Bachelor of Science in Computer Science at Asian School of Business is a three-year full-time course affiliated with CCSU. This undergraduate programme focuses on key areas of computer science, including coding, programming languages, computer hardware and software, networking, database management, information technology, mathematics, statistics, and electronics. 
In addition to the B.Sc. Computer Science degree, Asian School of Business, Noida, offers a range of specialised certifications and diplomas to enhance students’ qualifications and employability. These include: Certificate in AI and Machine Learning using Python Programming, Certificate in IoT: Internet of Things, Certificate in Data Science, Certificate in Backend Engineering, Diploma in New Media Applications, and Certificate in Corporate Communication.
